# DocuMind AI

> Privacy-first PDF, Auto Document Scanner, Exam Photo Resizer, Format Converter, and Bilingual (English + Tamil) Cited AI Document Workspace.

## Key Capabilities
- **Auto Document Scanner** (`/app/tools/scan`): Hands-free live camera scanner with automatic document edge detection, perspective cropping, page-change auto-capture, and multi-page PDF export.
- **Exact-KB PDF Compressor** (`/app/tools/compress`): Compress PDFs to exact portal limits (100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, or custom KB) with transparent metrics and immutable v1 history.
- **Student Photo & Signature Resizer** (`/app/tools/photo-resizer`): 1-click dimension and KB presets for Passport, Signature, GATE/JEE, UPSC/TNPSC, and PAN.
- **Merge, Split & PDF Studio** (`/app/tools/pdf`, `/app`): Combine, split, reorder, rotate, watermark, page-number, and password-protect/unlock PDFs.
- **Universal Format Converter** (`/app/tools/convert`): Convert across PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, Markdown, TXT, HTML, CSV, JSON, PNG, and JPG with visual verification.
- **Bilingual OCR (English + Tamil)** (`/app/tools/ocr`): Extract searchable text from scanned PDFs and camera images.
- **AI Search & Cited Q&A** (`/app/intelligence`): Ask grounded questions across documents with page-level citations.
- **Agent Workflows** (`/app/workflows`): Natural-language multi-step document pipelines with explicit user approval before execution.

## Privacy & Security Guarantees
- Zero AI model training on user documents.
- Guest Mode requires no signup; guest documents and sessions auto-delete after 1 hour or immediately via "Delete now".
- Original uploaded files stay preserved as immutable v1; every edit writes a new version.
- India DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR aligned (`/privacy`, `/security`, `/terms`).
